preconditions.description: The sizes of the two sequences are between 1 and 20 inclusive.
The input provides exactly n strings for sequence s and m strings for sequence t.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(x) <= 10 and x.islower() and x.isalpha() for x in s + t)
preconditions.description: All strings in both sequences consist only of lowercase letters and have lengths between 1 and 10.
The number of queries is between 1 and 2020 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y <= 10**9 for y in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query year y is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i] == s[(queries[i] - 1) % n] + t[(queries[i] - 1) % m] for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query year y, the output is the concatenation of the string from sequence s at index (y-1) mod n and the string from sequence t at index (y-1) mod m.
